headline: Expiry‑day trades are costing you a lot

expiry_day_trading.why_it_matters: The expiry‑day slice accounts for 90 trades and generated a loss of ₹1,16,891. On average each of those trades lost ₹1,299, had a win rate of 29% and produced a 28% loss, while the rest of your trades (124 of them) averaged a loss of ₹449, a 5% loss and a win rate of 37%. Overall this behaviour cost you ₹1,16,891.
expiry_day_trading.rule: Set a hard cap on expiry-day trades before the open.

closing: Consider applying the rule to limit expiry‑day trades before the market opens next month.
